entries.name: tone
entries.description: The fill inside the outline: paper, or the lightest screentone grey.

entries.name: font
entries.description: `dialogue` sets the narration in the lettering face; `body` in the page's body face.

entries.name: corner
entries.description:
`none` keeps the box in the flow. A corner places it absolutely on that corner of its
nearest positioned parent (a `panel`), its outline overlapping the parent's frame, so the
parent's content needs room on that side: one line of the box is
`calc(var(--text-sm)*var(--leading-snug)+--spacing(3))` tall (about 2 rem), and with a
panel's gap that is `pt-[calc(var(--text-sm)*var(--leading-snug)+--spacing(6))]` (about
2.75 rem, `pt-11`) for a top corner, `pb-…` for a bottom one; add a line for each line it
wraps to. `<Panel caption>` draws this same box and keeps that room for you.

entries.name: aria-label
entries.description: Names the box (the narrator, say) and exposes it as a `note`. Without it, plain text.

Chapter.name: Chapter
Chapter.description: One chapter of the series, as `ChapterList` takes it.

entries.name: number
entries.description: The chapter's number: `12`, or a string for one that is not a whole number (`"12.5"`).

entries.name: title
entries.description: The chapter's title.

entries.name: href
entries.description: Where the row links: the chapter's reader page.

entries.name: date
entries.description: When it came out, as it should read ("2026-11-02", "Nov 2"); shown as written.

entries.name: read
entries.description: Whether the reader has read it: the title is struck through and the state announced.

entries.name: chapters
entries.description: The series' chapters, in any order; each row links to its `href`.

entries.name: order
entries.description:
`desc` lists the newest chapter first; `asc` in reading order. Rows are ordered by number,
with numbers that are not numbers ("Extra") after the numbered ones.

entries.name: latest
entries.description:
Stamps the highest-numbered chapter (NEW, or 最新 with `numerals="ja"`), the first row of a
`desc` list.

entries.name: numerals
entries.description:
`latin` writes "Chapter 12"; `ja` writes 第12話 under `lang="ja"`, with the stamp and the
announced read state in Japanese too.

entries.name: label
entries.description: The navigation landmark's name, which tells it apart from the page's other navs.

entries.name: name
entries.description: The character's name: the card's heading and the article's name.

entries.name: reading
entries.description: How the name is read, set as ruby over it under `lang="ja"` (あまの みお).

entries.name: castRole
entries.description: The part they play: Protagonist, Rival…, in a caption box.

entries.name: portrait
entries.description: The portrait, in a 3:4 manga-frame.

entries.name: quote
entries.description: A line the character says, in a speech bubble.

entries.name: stats
entries.description: Stats as power gauges, listed in a description list with each value as text.

entries.name: status
entries.description: One stamp word pressed on the portrait's top corner (MAIN, 新人).

entries.name: href
entries.description: Makes the whole card one link to the character's page, named by the name.

entries.name: src
entries.description: The picture's URL, passed to a plain ``.

entries.name: alt
entries.description: Who is shown and how, for readers who cannot see it.

CharacterStat.name: CharacterStat
CharacterStat.description: One stat, drawn as a power gauge and given as text.

entries.name: label
entries.description: What is measured ("Speed").

entries.name: value
entries.description: The stat's value.

entries.name: max
entries.description: The value of a full gauge.

entries.name: prefix
entries.description:
Prepended to every pattern id, for a second set on one page in another colour
(`prefix="spot-"` defines `spot-tone-dots-2`). Name them with `chartToneFill(tone, prefix)`.

entries.name: className
entries.description:
Classes on the hidden `<svg>` that holds the defs. Its text colour is the patterns' colour:
they draw in `currentColor` where they are defined, so `className="text-spot"` makes a spot
set. The svg takes no space.

entries.name: kind
entries.description: The mark to draw; it also gives the default label ("Sweat drop", "Anger mark" …).

entries.name: size
entries.description: Mark size: 20, 32 or 48 px square.

entries.name: color
entries.description: Stroke colour: ink, spot red or the mid tone.

entries.name: decorative
entries.description: Hide the mark from assistive tech when the surrounding text already says it.

entries.name: color
entries.description: Line colour: ink, or the mid tone for a quieter background.

entries.name: center
entries.description: Where the lines converge, in percent of the box: `[x, y]`.

entries.name: count
entries.description: Number of lines.

entries.name: length
entries.description: How far the lines reach in towards the centre.

entries.name: className
entries.description:
Classes for the layer. It fills its `relative isolate` parent (`absolute inset-0 -z-1`) and
clips the lines to its own box, so the parent need not clip; an `inset-*` class moves its
edges (`inset-(--outline-width-heavy)` keeps the lines inside a panel's stroke).

entries.name: tone
entries.description: How dark the screen is: the theme's light, mid or dark halftone.

entries.name: size
entries.description: Dot and cell size: the theme's screen, or 1.5 or 2.5 times it.

entries.name: fade
entries.description: Fades the screen out towards the top, the bottom or the edges.

entries.name: direction
entries.description: Where the head points.

entries.name: curve
entries.description: Bows the shaft to the arrow's own left or right, seen along its direction.

entries.name: length
entries.description: Shaft length: 40, 72 or 112 px.

entries.name: color
entries.description: Pen colour: ink, or spot red for the one thing on the page to look at.

entries.name: label
entries.description:
Text at the arrow's tail ("Start here"). With a label the arrow is `role="img"` named by it;
without one it is decoration and `aria-hidden`.

entries.name: seed
entries.description: Same seed, same wobble. Defaults to a stable hash of `useId()`.

entries.name: shape
entries.description: `line` draws one stroke across the box, horizontal or vertical by aspect ratio.

entries.name: fill
entries.description: What fills the outline: nothing, paper, solid ink, the mid tone, or pencil hatching.

entries.name: shadow
entries.description: A hatched or solid ink shadow; mangacn draws none unless a component asks for one.

entries.name: seed
entries.description: Same seed, same wobble. Defaults to a stable hash of `useId()`.

entries.name: outline
entries.description:
A custom outline (a speech bubble with its tail, a burst): an SVG path in border-box
pixels, `0 0` at the top-left corner, drawn instead of `shape`'s outline with the same pen,
fill and shadow. `shape` still picks the CSS fallback. A new function redraws, so memoise it.

entries.name: dashed
entries.description: Draws the stroke dashed (whisper and thought bubbles).

entries.name: as
entries.description: The element to render; use `span` inside phrasing content such as a button.

entries.name: kind
entries.description:
The annotation: an underline, a loop around the words, a box, a strike-through, a tone
highlight behind the glyphs, or brackets at the start and end of the phrase.

entries.name: color
entries.description:
Pen colour: ink, spot red or the mid tone. A highlight paints a light wash of it instead
(tone-2 for ink, tone-1 for tone, spot at 30 %), so the text keeps its contrast.

entries.name: show
entries.description:
Whether the mark is drawn. Turning it on draws the stroke on, line by line; under reduced
motion, and when the mark is already on at mount, it appears at once.

entries.name: seed
entries.description: Same seed, same wobble. Defaults to a stable hash of `useId()`.

entries.name: size
entries.description: Loader size: 24, 40 or 64 px square.

entries.name: label
entries.description: Announced to assistive tech and kept visually hidden.

entries.name: kind
entries.description:
The mark: a splash with flung droplets, a band of ink running down in drips, or a spray of
dots.

entries.name: size
entries.description: Drawing size: 64, 112 or 160 px square.

entries.name: color
entries.description: Ink colour: ink, or spot red.

entries.name: seed
entries.description:
Picks the shape: the same seed draws the same splatter, another seed a different one.
Defaults to a stable hash of `useId()`, so every instance on a page differs.

entries.name: src
entries.description: The picture's URL, passed to the ``. Pass `src` and `alt`, or `children`.

entries.name: alt
entries.description: Required with `src`: describe the picture, or pass `""` when it is purely decorative.

entries.name: children
entries.description:
A drawn or lettered scene in place of a picture, in the theme's fonts and tokens. It fills a
`relative isolate` box of the same aspect, clipped to the frame and centred on paper, so
`speed-lines` or `focus-lines` go in as its first child. Real text stays readable as text.

entries.name: aspect
entries.description: The picture's (or scene's) aspect ratio; a picture is cropped to fill (`object-cover`).

entries.name: matte
entries.description: A halftone mat between the frame and the picture.

entries.name: caption
entries.description: Shown under the frame in a `<figcaption>`.

entries.name: className
entries.description: Applied to the `

entries.name: page
entries.description: The number of this page.

entries.name: of
entries.description: The number of pages, printed after the page as `7 / 24` and read as "Page 7 of 24".

entries.name: side
entries.description:
The page's outer corner, which the folio hugs: `right` for a right-hand page (the
default, as on most manga pages), `left` for a left-hand one. It aligns the text; place
the folio itself with `absolute` and the corner's edges.

entries.name: chapter
entries.description: A small chapter mark above the number ("Ch. 12", or `第12話`), read before the page.

entries.name: pageKey
entries.description: Change it to turn the page; the children are the page shown for that key.

entries.name: direction
entries.description: `rtl` turns like a manga, spine on the right; `ltr` like a western book.

entries.name: duration
entries.description: Seconds per turn.

entries.name: tone
entries.description: Screentone over the paper inside the frame: halftone dots, diagonal lines or cross-hatching.

entries.name: shadow
entries.description: A hatched ink shadow behind the panel.

entries.name: caption
entries.description:
Narration box on one corner, rendered as text: the same box as caption-box's `corner`. The
panel keeps one line of room for it on that side; for a caption that wraps, add padding
on that side (`pt-16`), or the content runs under it.

entries.name: captionSide
entries.description: The corner the caption box sits on, its outline overlapping the panel's.

entries.name: captionFont
entries.description: The caption's face: `dialogue` (the lettering face, as caption-box) or `body`.

entries.name: as
entries.description: The element to render; its role is the panel's role.

entries.name: colSpan
entries.description: Columns the cell spans from `sm` up; `full` spans every column at every width.

entries.name: rowSpan
entries.description: Rows the cell spans from `sm` up.

entries.name: columns
entries.description:
1–4 columns from `sm` up (one on phones), or a count per breakpoint (`base`, `sm`, `md`,
`lg`): `{ base: 1, sm: 2, lg: 3 }`.

entries.name: gutter
entries.description: The paper gap between panels: 8, 16 or 24 px.

entries.name: label
entries.description: The stat's name, set in the display face above the bar; it also names the meter.

entries.name: value
entries.description: The current value, clamped to `0`…`max`.

entries.name: max
entries.description: The value of a full bar.

entries.name: segments
entries.description:
`0` (or none) draws one solid ink fill; a number splits the bar into that many ink blocks
with paper gaps, filling whole blocks only.

entries.name: color
entries.description: The fill: ink, or spot red for the one stat that matters.

entries.name: burst
entries.description:
Shows a tilted "MAX" beside the bar once the value reaches `max`. Its room is kept while
the bar is short of full, so gauges stacked in a column stay the same length. A gauge that
renders full shows it at once; one that fills (or turns `burst` on) later pops it in with
sfx-text's `enter="pop"`, at once under reduced motion.

entries.name: format
entries.description:
The value as text, shown beside the label and read as the meter's value. Defaults to
`7 / 10` on screen and "7 of 10" for assistive tech.

entries.name: number
entries.description: Its number, as the chapter list shows it.

entries.name: title
entries.description: Its title.

entries.name: series
entries.description: The series' name, above the chapter's.

entries.name: chapter
entries.description: The chapter on the page.

entries.name: pages
entries.description: The chapter's pages in reading order, as spread-viewer takes them.

entries.name: chapters
entries.description: Every chapter of the series, for the drawer's chapter list (as chapter-list takes them).

entries.name: direction
entries.description: `rtl` reads like a manga, `ltr` like a western book.

entries.name: page
entries.description:
The reader's page, controlled: an index into `pages`. Wire it to the address with
`useReader` (its `url` option) and pass `page` and `setPage` here. Leave it out to let the
reader keep the page.

entries.name: onPageChange
entries.description: Called with the new page (an index) whenever the reader turns.

entries.name: single
entries.description: One page at a time, for phones; pass it from a media query.

entries.name: as
entries.description:
`main` makes the reader the page's one main region, as a chapter page is. Use `section`
(a region named by the chapter) inside a page that has a main of its own.

Series.name: Series
Series.description: A manga series: what the page shows, in the shape a fetch would return it.

entries.name: title
entries.description: The series' title: the page's one `h1`.

entries.name: originalTitle
entries.description: The title in its original language (灯守り), shown under the `h1` with `titleLang`.

entries.name: titleLang
entries.description: The language of `originalTitle`.

entries.name: reading
entries.description: How the original title is read (ひもり), set as ruby over it.

entries.name: author
entries.description: Who writes it.

entries.name: artist
entries.description: Who draws it, when that is someone else.

entries.name: synopsis
entries.description: A few sentences about the story.

entries.name: status
entries.description: Stamped on the cover.

entries.name: cover
entries.description: The series' cover, in a 2:3 manga-frame.

entries.name: startHref
entries.description: Where "Start reading" goes: the first chapter's reader page.

entries.name: volumes
entries.description: The Volumes tab, as volume-grid takes them.

entries.name: chapters
entries.description: The Chapters tab, as chapter-list takes them.

entries.name: cast
entries.description: The Cast tab, one character-card each.

entries.name: series
entries.description: The series: title, credits, synopsis, status, cover and where reading starts.

entries.name: following
entries.description: Whether the reader follows the series; pass it with `onFollowingChange` to control it.

entries.name: defaultFollowing
entries.description: Whether the reader follows the series at first, when the header keeps it.

entries.name: onFollowingChange
entries.description: Called with the new state when Follow is pressed.

entries.name: size
entries.description: Text size, with the stroke and shadow scaled to match; `lg` and `xl` grow again from `sm` up.

entries.name: color
entries.description: Letter colour: paper with an ink stroke, ink with a paper stroke, or spot red.

entries.name: stroke
entries.description: Outlines the letters with the stroke colour.

entries.name: rotate
entries.description: Tilt in degrees.

entries.name: enter
entries.description: A one-shot entrance on mount. Skipped (shown at rest) under reduced motion.

entries.name: words
entries.description:
The sound effects, in order: plain strings, or `{ text, color, lang }` for a word with its
own colour or language. Rendered twice for a seamless loop.

entries.name: speed
entries.description: How long one pass of the words takes: 60, 40 or 20 seconds.

entries.name: direction
entries.description: Which way the words travel.

entries.name: color
entries.description:
The words' colour, as `sfx-text`'s: ink with a paper stroke, paper with an ink stroke, or
spot red.

entries.name: size
entries.description:
The words' size, as `sfx-text`'s: `sm` for a quiet strip, `lg` for a loud one. Each
group stays at least as wide as the viewport at every size.

entries.name: label
entries.description:
Names the band for assistive tech, followed by the words once, in a visually hidden
paragraph. Without it the band is decoration and wholly hidden.

entries.name: shape
entries.description:
The outline: an ellipse, a box, a spiky burst in bold capitals, or a dashed ellipse in
light italics.

entries.name: tail
entries.description: Where the tail leaves the bubble, pointing at the speaker; `none` draws no tail.

entries.name: tone
entries.description: `light` fills the bubble with the lightest tone instead of paper.

entries.name: font
entries.description: `dialogue` sets the text in the lettering face; `inherit` keeps the surrounding font.

entries.name: direction
entries.description: Lines radiating from `center`, or horizontal streaks fading towards the left or the right.

entries.name: density
entries.description: How close together the lines are drawn.

entries.name: color
entries.description: Line colour: ink, or the mid tone for a quieter background.

entries.name: center
entries.description: Where radial lines converge, in percent of the box: `[x, y]`.

entries.name: className
entries.description:
Classes for the layer. It fills its `relative isolate` parent (`absolute inset-0 -z-1`) and
clips the lines to its own box, so the parent need not clip; an `inset-*` class moves its
edges (`inset-(--outline-width-heavy)` keeps the lines inside a panel's stroke).

entries.name: src
entries.description: The page image's URL, passed to a plain ``.

entries.name: alt
entries.description: What the page shows, for readers who cannot see it.

entries.name: pages
entries.description: The pages in reading order. Portrait images read best (each frame is 3:4).

entries.name: direction
entries.description:
`rtl` reads like a manga: the earlier page on the right, Left arrow for the next spread;
`ltr` like a western book.

entries.name: start
entries.description:
The page to open at, as an index into `pages` (0 is the first); the viewer opens the spread
that holds it.

entries.name: onChange
entries.description: Called with the index of the new spread's first page whenever the reader turns.

entries.name: page
entries.description:
The reader's page, controlled: an index into `pages`. The viewer opens the spread that
holds it, and a turn calls `onPageChange` instead of moving on its own. A page outside the
book is clamped and reported once through `onPageChange`. Leave it out to use `start`.

entries.name: onPageChange
entries.description:
Called with the index of the new spread's first page whenever the reader turns, controlled
or not.

entries.name: single
entries.description: One page at a time, for phones; pass it from a media query.

entries.name: blank
entries.description:
What fills the side facing a lone page (the first page, an even last page): a halftone, the
inside of the cover. It fills a 3:4 box beside the page.

entries.name: label
entries.description: The region's name, which says what is being read ("Chapter 12").

entries.name: shape
entries.description: The seal's outline: a round hanko or a square one.

entries.name: color
entries.description: Ink colour: spot red like a real seal, or ink for a black rubber stamp.

entries.name: rotate
entries.description: Tilt in degrees; a stamp is rarely pressed straight.

entries.name: size
entries.description:
Seal size: 56, 80 or 112 px square, with the text scaled to match. Text that would overrun
the inner ring shrinks to fit inside it once the page has loaded; keep it to one or two
short words (at `lg`, about 8 Latin letters or 4 kanji stay readable).

entries.name: aria-label
entries.description:
Names the stamp as an image ("Approved") when its word is a picture rather than text to
read; the root becomes `role="img"`. Without it the stamp's text speaks for itself.

entries.name: seed
entries.description: Same seed, same wobble. Defaults to a stable hash of `useId()`.

entries.name: vertical
entries.description:
Sets the word top to bottom in one column, as a two-kanji hanko is cut (完結, 検印), in a
larger face that fills the seal; it still shrinks to fit inside the ring. Meant for one to
three CJK characters (the column is `vertical-rl`, upright).

entries.name: dots
entries.description: Dots in the trail, each smaller than the last.

entries.name: tailSide
entries.description: The side the trail of dots leaves from, towards the thinker.

entries.name: font
entries.description: `dialogue` sets the text in the lettering face; `inherit` keeps the surrounding font.

entries.name: orientation
entries.description:
How characters stand: Japanese upright with Latin on its side, everything upright, or
everything on its side.

entries.name: number
entries.description: The volume's number, shown as its folio and in its name ("Volume 3", 第3巻).

entries.name: title
entries.description: The volume's title.

entries.name: cover
entries.description: The cover, in a 2:3 manga-frame.

entries.name: href
entries.description: Where the volume's page is; the cover, number and title are one link to it.

entries.name: date
entries.description: When it came out, printed as given ("2026/10/05", "Oct 2026").

entries.name: isNew
entries.description: Stamps the cover NEW (最新 with `numerals="ja"`).

entries.name: src
entries.description: The cover's URL, passed to a plain ``. Portrait covers fill best (the frame is 2:3).

entries.name: alt
entries.description: What the cover shows, for readers who cannot see it.

entries.name: volumes
entries.description: The volumes, in the order to show them.

entries.name: columns
entries.description:
Covers per row: a count from `sm` up (one on phones), or one per breakpoint, as
panel-grid takes it. Covers past the widest row's count load lazily.

entries.name: numerals
entries.description:
`latin` names each volume "Volume 3"; `ja` writes 第3巻 under `lang="ja"`, with the stamp in
Japanese too.

entries.name: label
entries.description: The navigation landmark's name, which tells it apart from the page's other navs.
